articles.title_en: Do Credit Supply Shocks Affect Employment in Middle-Income Countries?
articles.title_cn: 信贷供给冲击是否影响中等收入国家的就业？
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of bank credit supply shocks on formal employment in Mexico using a proprietary dataset containing information on all loans extended to firms by commercial banks during 2010–2015. We find large impacts on the formal employment of small and medium firms: a positive credit shock of 1 standard deviation increases yearly employment by 1.4 percentage points. The shares of uncollateralized credit and credit received by family firms, younger firms, and firms with no previous bank relationships also increase, suggesting that credit shocks may play a more prominent role for employment creation in credit-constrained settings. (JEL D22, G21, G32, J23, L25, M51, O16)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用一个专有数据集，该数据集包含2010-2015年间商业银行向企业发放的所有贷款信息，研究了银行信贷供给冲击对墨西哥正规就业的影响。我们发现信贷冲击对中小企业的正规就业有显著影响：正向信贷冲击增加1个标准差，会使年就业增加1.4个百分点。无抵押信贷和由家族企业、年轻企业以及无先前银行关系的企业获得的信贷份额也有所增加，这表明在信贷受限的环境中，信贷冲击可能对就业创造发挥更突出的作用。（JEL D22, G21, G32, J23, L25, M51, O16）

articles.title_en: Public and Private Options in Practice: The Military Health System
articles.title_cn: 实践中的公共与私人选择：军事卫生系统
articles.abstract_en: Recent debates over health care reform, including in the context of the Military Health System (MHS) and Veterans Administration, highlight the dispute between public and private provision of health care services. Using novel data on childbirth claims from the MHS and drawing on the combination of plausibly exogenous patient moves and heterogeneity across bases in the availability of base hospitals, we identify the impact of receiving obstetrical care on versus off military bases. We find evidence that off-base care is associated with slightly greater resource intensity, but also notably better outcomes, suggesting marginal efficiency gains from care privatization. (JEL H51, H56, I11, I18, J13, L33)
articles.abstract_cn: 近期关于医疗改革的辩论，包括在军事卫生系统（MHS）和退伍军人管理局的背景下，凸显了公共与私人提供医疗服务之间的争议。利用来自MHS的新颖分娩索赔数据，并结合看似外生的患者流动和不同基地在基地医院可用性上的异质性，我们识别了在军事基地内与基地外接受产科护理的影响。我们发现证据表明，基地外护理与略高的资源密集度相关，但同时也与显著更好的结果相关，这表明护理私有化带来了边际效率收益。（JEL H51, H56, I11, I18, J13, L33）

articles.title_en: Age Discrimination across the Business Cycle
articles.abstract_en: We test whether age discrimination rises during recessions using two complementary analyses. Confidential EEOC microdata reveal that age-related firing and hiring charges rise by 3.3 percent and 1.6 percent, respectively, for each percentage point increase in a state-industry’s monthly unemployment. Though the opportunity cost of filing falls, the fraction of meritorious claims increases—a sufficient condition for rising discrimination under plausible assumptions. Second, we repurpose data from hiring correspondence studies conducted across different cities and time periods during the recovery from the Great Recession. Each percentage point increase in local unemployment reduces the callback rate for older versus younger women by 15 percent. (JEL E32, J14, J16, J23, J71, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过两项互补分析检验年龄歧视是否在经济衰退期间加剧。机密的EEOC微观数据显示，州-行业月度失业率每上升一个百分点，与年龄相关的解雇和招聘指控分别上升3.3%和1.6%。尽管提起诉讼的机会成本下降，但有理有据的索赔比例增加——在合理假设下，这是歧视加剧的充分条件。其次，我们重新利用大衰退复苏期间在不同城市和时间段进行的招聘对应研究数据。当地失业率每上升一个百分点，老年女性相对于年轻女性的回电率下降15%。(JEL E32, J14, J16, J23, J71, M51)

articles.title_en: My Professor Cares: Experimental Evidence on the Role of Faculty Engagement
articles.title_cn: 我的教授关心：教师参与作用的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence on the impact of specific faculty behaviors aimed at increasing student success for college students from historically underrepresented groups. The intervention was developed after conducting in-person focus groups and a pilot experiment. We find significant positive treatment effects across a multitude of short- and longer-run outcomes. Specifically, underrep-resented students in the treatment report more positive perceptions of the professor and earned higher course grades. These positive effects persisted over the next several years, with students in the treatment more likely to persist in college, resulting in increased credit accumulation and degree completion. (JEL I22, I23, I28, J15, J44)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于特定教师行为对历史上代表性不足群体大学生学业成功影响的实验证据。该干预措施是在进行面对面焦点小组和试点实验后制定的。我们在众多短期和长期结果中发现了显著的正向处理效应。具体而言，处理组中代表性不足的学生对教授的看法更为积极，并获得了更高的课程成绩。这些积极效应在接下来的几年中持续存在，处理组的学生更有可能坚持完成大学学业，从而增加了学分积累和学位完成率。（JEL I22, I23, I28, J15, J44）

articles.title_en: Public Pension Reforms and Retirement Decisions: Narrative Evidence and Aggregate Implications
articles.title_cn: 公共养老金改革与退休决策：叙事证据与总体影响
articles.abstract_en: We construct a database of public pension policy changes with motivation and implementation information for ten OECD countries. Structural pension reforms, motivated by long-run sustainability concerns, often come with prolonged phase-in periods. In response to pension retrenchments implemented immediately, people close to retirement stay in the workforce longer. News about future pension retrenchments with implementation lags, however, is likely to lead this group to exit the labor market. This decline in the labor force participation rate is particularly strong for reforms with long lags, ones that introduce fundamental policy changes, and ones where citizens have lower trust in the government. (JEL E62, H55, J14, J22, J26)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含十个OECD国家公共养老金政策变化及其动机和实施信息的数据库。出于长期可持续性考虑的结构性养老金改革，往往伴随着较长的分阶段实施期。对于立即实施的养老金削减措施，接近退休年龄的人群会延长工作年限。然而，关于未来养老金削减且实施滞后的消息，则可能导致这一群体退出劳动力市场。这种劳动力参与率的下降，在实施滞后较长、引入根本性政策变化以及公民对政府信任度较低的情况下尤为显著。(JEL E62, H55, J14, J22, J26)

articles.title_en: Moved to Poverty? A Legacy of the Apartheid Experiment in South Africa
articles.title_cn: 被迫迁往贫困？南非种族隔离实验的遗产
articles.abstract_en: During the South African apartheid, Black people were forced to move to homelands during the 1960s and 1970s, resulting in one of history’s largest segregation policy experiments. We examine how and why relocation to the homelands affected human capital attainment. Exploiting the staggered timing of homeland establishment in a cross-cohort identification strategy, we find that moving to the home-lands during childhood significantly reduces educational attainment, labor earnings, and employment rates in adulthood. The data suggest an important role for place effects. Moving to the homelands in childhood implies greater exposure to poorer neighborhoods, and it disproportionally reduces human capital attainment. (JEL I26, J15, J24, J31, N37, O15, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 在南非种族隔离期间，黑人在1960年代和1970年代被迫迁往“黑人家园”，这成为历史上最大规模的种族隔离政策实验之一。我们研究了迁往家园如何以及为何影响人力资本积累。利用家园建立时间在不同队列中的交错性作为识别策略，我们发现童年时期迁往家园显著降低了成年后的教育成就、劳动收入和就业率。数据表明，地点效应发挥了重要作用。童年时期迁往家园意味着更多地暴露于更贫困的社区，并且不成比例地减少了人力资本积累。(JEL I26, J15, J24, J31, N37, O15, R23)

articles.title_en: Dynamic Impacts of School-Based Internet Access on Student Learning: Evidence from Peruvian Public Primary Schools
articles.title_cn: 学校互联网接入对学生学习的动态影响：来自秘鲁公立小学的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impacts of school-based internet access on second graders’ test scores, using over 2 million student observations from a panel of Peruvian public primary schools. We identify effects up to 6+ years after installation on different cohorts of second-grade students, exploiting variation in the timing of internet access induced by the rollout of a national program. We find positive but modest short-run impacts, but importantly, these effects grow for subsequent cohorts. Indeed, short-run estimates alone would have led to different conclusions. These dynamics underscore the value of extended evaluation windows to allow benefits of educational technology to materialize. (JEL I21, I26, I28, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用秘鲁公立小学的面板数据，包含超过2万个学生观测值，研究了学校互联网接入对二年级学生考试成绩的影响。我们利用国家项目推广过程中互联网接入时间的差异，识别了安装后长达6年以上的不同二年级学生群体的效应。我们发现短期影响虽为正但较为温和，但重要的是，这些效应在后续队列中有所增长。实际上，仅基于短期估计会得出不同的结论。这些动态变化强调了延长评估窗口的重要性，以便教育技术的好处得以显现。（JEL I21, I26, I28, O15）

articles.title_en: Effects of Maturing Private School Choice Programs on Public School Students
articles.title_cn: 成熟的私立学校选择项目对公立学校学生的影响
articles.abstract_en: Using a rich dataset that merges student-level school records with birth records, and leveraging a student fixed effects design, we explore how a Florida private school choice program affected public school students’ outcomes as the program matured and scaled up. We observe growing benefits (higher standardized test scores and lower absenteeism and suspension rates) to students attending public schools with more preprogram private school options as the program matured. Effects are particularly pronounced for lower-income students, but results are positive for more affluent students as well. Local and district-wide private school competition are both independently related to student outcomes. (JEL H75, I21, I22, I28)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用一个将学生层面的学校记录与出生记录合并的丰富数据集，并采用学生固定效应设计，我们探讨了佛罗里达州的一个私立学校选择项目在成熟和扩大规模过程中如何影响公立学校学生的结果。随着项目的成熟，我们观察到就读于项目前私立学校选择更多的公立学校的学生获得了越来越多的益处（标准化测试成绩更高，缺勤率和停学率更低）。对于低收入学生而言，这些效应尤为显著，但对较富裕学生而言结果也是积极的。地方和学区范围内的私立学校竞争均与学生结果独立相关。（JEL H75, I21, I22, I28）

articles.title_cn: 宏观审慎监管中的选举周期
articles.abstract_en: Do politics matter for macroprudential policies? I show that changes in macroprudential regulation exhibit a predictable electoral cycle in the run-up to 221 elections across 58 countries from 2000 through 2014. Policies restricting mortgages and consumer credit are systematically looser before elections, particularly during economic expansions. Consistent with theories of opportunistic political cycles, this pattern is stronger when election outcomes are uncertain, regulators are closely tied to politicians, and institutions are poor. These results suggest that political pressures may limit the ability of regulators to “lean against the wind.” (JEL D72, E32, G01, G21, G28)
articles.abstract_cn: 政治因素对宏观审慎政策有影响吗？我展示了在2000年至2014年间，58个国家的宏观审慎监管变化在221次选举前呈现出可预测的选举周期。限制抵押贷款和消费信贷的政策在选举前系统性放松，尤其是在经济扩张期间。与机会主义政治周期理论一致，这种模式在选举结果不确定、监管者与政治家关系密切以及制度薄弱时更为明显。这些结果表明，政治压力可能限制监管者“逆风而行”的能力。（JEL D72, E32, G01, G21, G28）

articles.title_en: Market Power and Price Exposure: Learning from Changes in Renewable Energy Regulation
articles.title_cn: 市场势力与价格暴露：从可再生能源监管变化中学习
articles.abstract_en: Given the critical role of renewable energies in current and future electricity markets, it is important to understand how they affect firms’ pricing incentives. We study whether the price-depressing effect of renewables depends on their degree of market price exposure. Paying renewables with fixed prices, rather than market-based prices, is more effective at curbing market power when the dominant firms own large shares of renewables, and vice versa. Our empirical short-lived changes to renewables regulation in the Spanish market and shows that switching from full-price exposure to fixed prices caused a 2–4 percent reduction in the average price-cost markup. (JEL L13, L94, L98, Q42, Q48)
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于可再生能源在当前和未来电力市场中的关键作用，理解它们如何影响企业的定价激励十分重要。我们研究了可再生能源的价格抑制效应是否取决于其市场价格暴露程度。当主导企业拥有大量可再生能源份额时，以固定价格而非市场价格支付可再生能源，在抑制市场势力方面更为有效，反之亦然。我们对西班牙市场可再生能源监管的短期变化进行的实证研究表明，从完全价格暴露转向固定价格导致平均价格-成本加成率下降了2-4%。（JEL L13, L94, L98, Q42, Q48）

articles.title_en: The Effects of Import Competition on Unionization
articles.title_cn: 进口竞争对工会化的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study direct and indirect effects of Chinese import competition on union membership in the United States, 1990–2014. Import competition in manufacturing induced a modest decline in unionization within manufacturing industries. The magnitude is small because unionized manufacturers competed in higher-quality product segments. Manufacturers in right-to-work states experienced more direct competition with low-quality Chinese imports. Outside of manufacturing, however, import competition causes an important increase in union membership, as less educated women shift away from retail and toward jobs in health care and education where unions are stronger. We calculate that Chinese imports prevented 26 percent of the union density decline that would have otherwise occurred. (JEL F14, F16, J16, J51, L60, P33)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了1990-2014年间中国进口竞争对美国工会会员人数的直接和间接影响。制造业中的进口竞争导致制造业行业内工会化程度出现适度下降。这一幅度较小，因为工会化的制造商在更高质量的产品细分市场竞争。在拥有工作权法的州，制造商面临来自低质量中国进口商品的更直接竞争。然而，在制造业之外，进口竞争导致工会会员人数显著增加，因为受教育程度较低的女性从零售业转向医疗保健和教育行业，这些行业的工会更为强大。我们计算得出，中国进口阻止了本可能发生的工会密度下降的26%。（JEL F14, F16, J16, J51, L60, P33）

articles.title_en: Information and Spillovers from Targeting Policy in Peru’s Anchoveta Fishery
articles.title_cn: 秘鲁鳀鱼渔业中目标政策的信息与溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper establishes that a targeted policy backfires because it reveals information about nontargeted units. In the world’s largest fishery, the regulator attempts to reduce the harvesting of juvenile fish by temporarily closing areas where the share of juvenile catch is high. By combining administrative microdata with biologically richer data from fishing firms, I isolate variation in closures that is due to the regulator’s lower-resolution data. I estimate substantial temporal and spatial spillovers from closures. Closures increase total juvenile catch by 48 percent because closure announcements implicitly signal that fishing before, just outside, and after closures is high productivity. (JEL D83, O13, Q21, Q22, Q28)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文证实了一项目标政策因揭示了非目标单位的信息而适得其反。在全球最大的渔业中，监管机构试图通过暂时关闭幼鱼捕捞比例较高的区域来减少幼鱼的捕捞。通过将行政微观数据与渔业公司提供的生物学更丰富的数据相结合，我分离了因监管机构较低分辨率数据而导致的关闭变化。我估计了关闭带来的显著时间和空间溢出效应。关闭使幼鱼总捕捞量增加了48%，因为关闭公告隐含地表明，在关闭之前、紧邻关闭区域之外以及关闭之后进行捕捞具有高生产率。(JEL D83, O13, Q21, Q22, Q28)

articles.title_en: Digitization and the Market for Physical Works: Evidence from the Google Books Project
articles.title_cn: 数字化与实体作品市场：来自谷歌图书项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: The free digital distribution of creative works could cannibalize demand for physical versions, but it could also boost physical sales by enabling consumers to discover the original work. We study the impact of the Google Books digitization project on the market for physical books. We find that digitization significantly boosts the demand for physical versions and provide evidence for the discovery channel. Moreover, digitization allows independent publishers to introduce new editions for existing books, further increasing sales. Our results highlight the potential of free digital distribution to strengthen the demand for and supply of physical products. (JEL D12, L82, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 创意作品的免费数字分发可能会蚕食实体版本的需求，但也可能通过使消费者发现原作来促进实体销售。我们研究了谷歌图书数字化项目对实体书市场的影响。我们发现数字化显著提升了实体版本的需求，并为发现渠道提供了证据。此外，数字化使独立出版商能够为现有书籍推出新版本，进一步增加销售。我们的结果凸显了免费数字分发在增强实体产品需求和供给方面的潜力。（JEL D12, L82, L86）

articles.title_cn: 英国脱欧不确定性及其（非）服务效应
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of increased policy uncertainty from Brexit on UK trade in services. We apply an uncertainty-augmented gravity equation to UK services trade with the European Union at the industry level from 2016:I to 2018:IV. By exploiting the variation in the probability of Brexit from prediction markets interacted with a new trade policy risk measure across service industries, we identify a significant negative impact of the threat of Brexit on trade values and participation. The increased probability of Brexit in this period lowered services exports by at least 20 log points. (JEL F13, F14, F15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估算了英国脱欧带来的政策不确定性增加对英国服务贸易的影响。我们将不确定性增强的引力方程应用于2016年第一季度至2018年第四季度英国与欧盟在行业层面的服务贸易。通过利用预测市场中脱欧概率的变化与跨服务行业的新贸易政策风险度量之间的交互作用，我们识别出脱欧威胁对贸易额和参与度的显著负面影响。该时期脱欧概率的增加使服务出口至少下降了20个对数点。（JEL F13, F14, F15）

articles.title_en: Do Tax Incentives Increase Firm Innovation? An RD Design for R&D, Patents, and Spillovers
articles.title_cn: 税收激励是否增加企业创新？研发、专利和溢出效应的断点回归设计
articles.abstract_en: We present causal evidence of R&D tax incentives’ positive impacts on a firm’s own innovation and that of its technological neighbors. Exploiting a change in size-based eligibility thresholds for R&D tax relief, we implement a Regression Discontinuity Design using administrative data. We find significant effects of tax relief on (quality-adjusted) patenting (and R&D) that persist up to seven years, and evidence of R&D spillovers on the innovation of technologically close firms. We can rule out elasticities of patenting with respect to R&D user cost of under 2 at the 5 percent level and show that our large effects are driven by financially constrained treated firms. (JEL D22, H25, H32, O31, O34)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了研发税收激励对企业自身创新及其技术邻近企业创新的因果证据。利用基于规模资格的研发税收减免门槛变化，我们使用行政数据实施断点回归设计。我们发现税收减免对（质量调整后的）专利申请（和研发）有显著影响，且影响持续长达七年，并提供了研发溢出效应对技术相近企业创新的证据。我们可以在5%水平上排除专利申请相对于研发用户成本的弹性低于2的情况，并表明我们的显著效应是由财务受限的处理企业驱动的。（JEL D22, H25, H32, O31, O34）

articles.title_cn: 青少年犯罪与预期惩罚
articles.abstract_en: Can sanctions deter juvenile crime? Research indicates that they may not, as offending barely decreases when individuals cross the age of criminal majority and begin to face harsher sanctions. Several models of criminal behavior predict, however, that these small reactions close to the threshold may mask larger behavioral responses among individuals below the age threshold. Policy variation between 2007–2015 in the United States is used to show evidence consistent with these predictions—juvenile crime increases when the age of majority is increased. This increase is driven by younger age groups and is considerably larger than discontinuity estimates at the threshold. (JEL D91, J13, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 制裁能否威慑青少年犯罪？研究表明，它们可能不能，因为当个人跨过刑事责任年龄并开始面临更严厉的制裁时，犯罪行为几乎没有减少。然而，几种犯罪行为模型预测，接近门槛的这些微小反应可能掩盖了低于年龄门槛的个体中更大的行为反应。利用美国2007-2015年间的政策变化，提供了与这些预测一致的证据——当成年年龄提高时，青少年犯罪增加。这种增加由较年轻的年龄组驱动，并且比门槛处的断点估计要大得多。（JEL D91, J13, K42）
